description: Open an interactive device session on a URL (iPhone/Android/iPad preset). Returns the first observation: screenshot, labeled interactive elements (refs e1..eN with selector/role/name/rect), layout diagnostics, and console/page errors. Use session_act to tap/type/scroll, then read the fresh observation it returns.

engine.description: webkit gives a Safari-flavoured approximation (no recording/CDP a11y)

selector.description: Wait for this selector before observing

waitMs.description: Wait after load before the first observation (default 800)

name: session_start
